subject.title: [Feature]: Store configuration backup files in their own directory, with datetime name convention

question: Should core config backups move to a dedicated `config-backup/` directory with datetime names, or should OpenClaw keep the adjacent backup layout and only change naming or docs?
rationale: The source change is feasible, but AGENTS.md and VISION.md make config layout, recovery, migration, and backup retention a compatibility-sensitive product decision before implementation.

options.title: Adopt the dedicated directory layout
options.body: Make this issue the canonical design and require a migration-safe implementation covering legacy `.bak.N` files, recovery, permissions, retention, audit text, doctor docs, and tests.

options.title: Limit scope to timestamp suffixes
options.body: Keep backups adjacent and route the naming-only work through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39923 and its PR, while closing or narrowing this directory request.

options.title: Keep the current ring
options.body: Reject the layout change and document the adjacent numbered backup ring as the intended stable behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt the dedicated directory layout
recommendation.body: Make this issue the canonical design and require a migration-safe implementation covering legacy `.bak.N` files, recovery, permissions, retention, audit text, doctor docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue already has steipete's review context, and recent commits/comments show direct involvement in the config backup and recovery surface.
